#BlackHistoryMonth     book recommendation for 2/9/2022:
I pray that #BlackLivesMatter work honors the painstaking, courageous labor of the Black women who led the 19th-20th century anti-lynching movement. 
#MustRead
Southern Horrors by Ida B. Wells-Barnett
